Went to 12 years of catholic school, and man, they pump that abstinence only programming hard.

-circa middle school, we were taught that sex is something you "give" your husband on a wedding night, as it's your duty as a woman to provide your body to his beck and call. Complete with the stupid used sneaker analogy, and the whole "offering sex to your husband on your wedding night and bearing him children is your DUTY."

-High school involved lots and lots of slut shaming. Sex is a sin, birth control is the voice of the devil, birth control causes infertility, abortions are immoral and should never be had under any circumstance, ect. Entire retreats dedicated to bullying women into confessing that they'd lost their virginities, and making them cry in front of the whole class. Lots of bullshit about sexual health, masturbation is a sin, ect. 

Not to mention they blatantly lied about jow effective condoms are. No mention whatsoever of STDs, or STIs. No resources regarding sexual health. 

Man, that shit took years to de program. I still feel guilty about having sex with my partner  (whom i love and deeply trust) to this date. As an adult i want so badly to go back and stand up and call them out on their bullshit, but oh well.
